answers.en: I applied last week. Any update?
answers.note: any update 是最常用的跟进说法。

answers.en: Could you check the status of my application?
answers.note: 更正式，status 指申请状态。
answers.zh: 能帮我查一下申请状态吗？

answers.en: Is there anything else you need from me?
answers.note: 把球踢给对方，显得主动又不催。

items.scene: 你问在这家公司上班的朋友

answers.en: Can you refer me for the job?
answers.zh: 能帮我内推这个岗位吗？

answers.en: Would you be able to refer me?
Is there an internal referral program?
answers.note: 问公司有没有内推机制，不直接麻烦对方。

answers.en: Will the interview be online or in person?
Is it a video interview or onsite?
answers.note: onsite 是到公司现场，招聘常用。
answers.zh: 是视频面试还是到公司？

answers.en: Do I come to the office?
answers.note: 最口语，确认要不要去公司。

answers.en: Should I bring my portfolio?
Do you want to see samples of my work?
answers.note: samples of my work 更口语。

answers.en: Can I send my portfolio by email instead?
answers.zh: 能改成邮件发作品集吗？

answers.en: Do I need to bring my diploma?
Should I bring proof of my degree?
answers.note: proof of degree 是学历证明。

answers.en: Is a copy of my certificate enough?
Can we do the interview over video?
Is a video interview possible?
Could we meet online instead?
What app will we use for the video interview?
Do you use Zoom or Teams?
answers.note: 报两个常见软件，对方直接选。
answers.zh: 你们用 Zoom 还是 Teams？

answers.en: Will you send me a link?

items.scene: 视频面试开始前你跟 HR 说

answers.en: My camera won't turn on.
I can't get my camera to work.
Can you hear me without video?
Would an in-person interview work instead?
answers.note: in-person 是当面，would ... work 更委婉。

answers.en: Could I come to the office for the interview?
Is an onsite interview possible?

items.scene: 你收到改期通知后问 HR

answers.en: What's the new interview time?
answers.note: new 强调改过之后的时间。

answers.en: Did the interview move to three?
Could you text me the new time?
answers.note: 请对方把新时间发短信，最省事。
answers.zh: 能把新时间发我短信吗？

items.scene: 面试路上你打电话给 HR

answers.en: I might be ten minutes late.
answers.note: might 留余地，但已经告知。

answers.en: I'm running about ten minutes behind.
answers.note: running behind 是落后于计划，很自然。

answers.en: Would it be okay if I arrived ten minutes late?
How do I get to the interview location?
What's the address?
Which exit should I take from the subway?
answers.note: 问地铁哪个口出，很实用。

items.scene: 你开车去面试，打电话问 HR

answers.en: Is there parking nearby?
Where can I park?
Do you have visitor parking?
answers.note: visitor parking 是访客停车位。

answers.en: How many rounds of interviews are there?
Is there more than one round?
answers.note: 更简单，问是不是不止一轮。

answers.en: What are the next steps after this?
answers.note: 问接下来流程，比问轮次更自然。

answers.en: When is the next round?
When would the second interview be?
How soon will I hear about the next round?

items.scene: 面试结束后你发邮件问 HR

answers.en: Could you give me some feedback?
What could I improve?
Was there anything I should work on?
answers.note: work on 是改进，语气柔和。
answers.zh: 有什么我需要提升的吗？

answers.en: Could you tell me why I wasn't selected?
answers.note: selected 是录用，正式但不生硬。
answers.zh: 能告诉我为什么没选我吗？

answers.en: What was missing in my interview?
Is there any feedback you can share?
answers.note: share 比 give 更委婉。
answers.zh: 有什么能分享的反馈吗？

answers.en: Could you reconsider my application?
answers.zh: 能再考虑一下我的申请吗？

answers.en: Is there any chance you'd take another look?
Would it help if I sent more examples of my work?
answers.note: 主动补材料，显得有诚意。
answers.zh: 我再发些作品会有帮助吗？

items.zh: 有其他适合我的岗位吗？

answers.en: Are there other roles that might fit me?
answers.zh: 有其他适合我的岗位吗？

answers.en: Do you have any other openings?
Should I apply for a different position?
How big is the team?
How many people are on the team?
Who would I work with?
Who would I report to?
answers.note: report to 是汇报对象，职场标准说法。

answers.en: Who would be my manager?
Who would I work under?
answers.note: work under 也是向谁汇报，稍口语。

answers.en: What tools does the team use?
Do you use Jira or something similar?
answers.note: 报一个具体工具，方便对方回答。
answers.zh: 你们用 Jira 之类的吗？

answers.en: What software would I be working in?
What's the company culture like?
How would you describe the work environment?
answers.note: work environment 更具体，问工作氛围。
answers.zh: 你怎么形容这里的工作氛围？

answers.en: What's it like to work here?
answers.zh: 在这儿工作是什么感觉？

answers.en: Is there training for new hires?
Do you offer onboarding training?
Will someone show me the ropes?
answers.note: show someone the ropes 是带新人上手，很地道。

answers.en: How does promotion work here?
answers.zh: 这儿的晋升是怎么定的？

answers.en: What does it take to move up?
answers.note: move up 是往上走，口语。

answers.en: Is there a clear path for growth?
How much travel is involved?
answers.note: involved 是这份工作涉及的，正式。

answers.en: Do I need to travel often?
Is this a travel-heavy role?
answers.note: travel-heavy 是出差多，招聘常用。

answers.en: Where is the office located?
Which office would I work from?
answers.note: 公司有多个办公点时用。

answers.en: Is the job based downtown?
answers.note: downtown 是市中心，问具体位置。

answers.en: What should I put for expected salary?
Should I give a range?
answers.note: range 是区间，问要不要写范围。

answers.en: Is it okay to write negotiable?
Is the salary negotiable?
Can we talk about the salary?
Is there room to negotiate?
answers.note: room 是空间，问有没有余地。

answers.en: Do I have to share my last salary?
answers.zh: 一定要说上一份工资吗？

answers.en: Is my previous pay required?
answers.zh: 需要提供之前的薪资吗？

answers.en: Can I skip that question?

items.scene: 你收到 offer 后问 HR

answers.en: How long is the offer valid?
When do I need to decide by?
answers.note: decide by 是截止到什么时候决定。
answers.zh: 我最晚什么时候要决定？

answers.en: Does the offer expire?
answers.note: expire 是过期，问会不会失效。

answers.en: Can I have a few days to think it over?
answers.note: think it over 是考虑一下。

answers.en: Is it okay to take the weekend to decide?
When do you need my answer?

items.scene: 你在电话里跟 HR 谈

answers.en: Could you increase the offer?
answers.note: increase 是提高，直接但礼貌。

answers.en: Is there any flexibility on the salary?
answers.note: flexibility 是弹性空间，很委婉。

answers.en: Would you consider a higher number?
answers.note: higher number 指更高的数字，留余地。

items.zh: 什么时候能收到正式 offer？

answers.en: When will I get the formal offer?
answers.note: formal offer 是正式录用通知。
answers.zh: 什么时候能收到正式 offer？

answers.en: Will the offer come by email?
How soon should I expect it?
Do I need a health check before I start?
Is a medical exam required?
Where do I get the health check done?
Do you need my resignation letter from my last job?
answers.note: resignation letter 是离职证明/辞职信。
answers.zh: 需要上一家的离职证明吗？

answers.en: Is a release letter required?
answers.note: release letter 是解除劳动关系证明。
answers.zh: 需要解除劳动合同证明吗？

answers.en: What proof do you need that I left my last job?
answers.note: 问需要什么材料证明已离职。

answers.en: Do you run background checks?
Will you contact my references?
What does the background check cover?
Will you contact my previous employer?
answers.zh: 会联系我上一家公司吗？

answers.en: Do you call my old company?
answers.zh: 会给我前公司打电话吗？

answers.en: Can I ask you not to contact my current employer?
answers.note: 在职找工作时常问，礼貌但明确。
answers.zh: 能不联系我现在这家公司吗？

answers.en: Is there a non-compete agreement?
Do I have to sign a non-compete?
How long does the non-compete last?
Can my social insurance transfer over?
answers.note: social insurance 是社保，transfer over 是转过来。

answers.en: Will you handle the transfer?
answers.note: 问公司办不办转移手续。

answers.en: What do I need to do about my social insurance?
answers.zh: 社保这边我需要做什么？

answers.en: What's the process for becoming a full employee?
How does the probation review work?
answers.note: probation review 是试用期考核。

answers.en: When is the decision made?
Can the probation period be shortened?
Is three months possible instead of six?
answers.zh: 能三个月而不是六个月吗？

answers.en: Can I become full-time earlier?
answers.note: full-time 是正式，问能不能提前转正。

answers.en: Can I start earlier?
Could I begin next week?
Is an earlier start date possible?
answers.note: start date 是入职日期，正式。

answers.en: Is there training in the first week?
What happens on the first day?
Will I shadow someone at first?
answers.note: shadow someone 是跟着别人学。

answers.en: Is there a company shuttle?
Does the company provide a bus?
Where does the shuttle pick up?
Are the hours flexible?
Can I start at ten instead of nine?
answers.zh: 我能十点而不是九点上班吗？

answers.en: Is there a flex-time policy?
answers.note: flex-time policy 是弹性工作制度，正式。

answers.en: Can I get reimbursed for travel to the interview?
Do you cover interview travel costs?
answers.zh: 面试交通费你们承担吗？

answers.en: Is there a travel allowance for candidates?
answers.note: travel allowance 是交通补贴，正式。

answers.en: Is there a written test?
Will I have to do a test?
Is there a technical assessment?
answers.note: technical assessment 是技术评估，岗位相关时用。
